engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Air leak in  Air Ride Suspension System
technicalNotes: On vehicles with Air Ride Suspension, a leak in the system will cause the Air Compressor Motor to run too long and flag this code.
